subtitle: Prevalence of night blindness (a symptom of moderate-to-severe vitamin-A deficiency) in pre-school children (aged under-5), measured as the percentage of children with night blindness during the period 1995-2005.

title: Share of pregnant women who have night blindness
subtitle: Share of pregnant women with night blindness, a symptom of moderate-to-severe vitamin A deficiency in pregnant women, during the period 1995–2005. Night blindness makes it difficult for you to see in low-light conditions.

title: Number of people with river blindness per 100,000
subtitle: The estimated rate of people living with river blindness per 100,000 people. River blindness is an eye infection caused by parasitic worms that can lead to blindness.

title: Share of adults who smoke or use other tobacco
subtitle: Estimated percentage of people aged 15 and older who currently use tobacco. This includes all forms of tobacco use, such as smoking, chewing or snuffing, but excludes products that do not contain tobacco, such as e-cigarettes.

title: Share of people who are undernourished
Share of children who have vitamin A deficiency
subtitle: Prevalence of vitamin-A deficiency in pre-school children (aged under-5), measured as the percentage of children with serum retinol levels <0.7µmol/l (a key indicator of vitamin-A deficiency) during the period 1995-2005.

title: Share of pregnant women who have vitamin A deficiency
subtitle: Prevalence of vitamin A deficiency in pregnant women, measured as the percentage of women with serum retinol levels <0.7 µmol/l, during the period 1995–2005.

title: Share of the population with cardiovascular disease
subtitle: Estimated prevalence of cardiovascular diseases, as a share of the population.

title: Primary school completion rates, adjusted gender parity index
subtitle: An adjusted gender parity index of 1 indicates equal primary school completion rates between boys and girls. Values below 1 favor boys, and above 1 favor girls.

title: Share of children in primary school age who are in school
subtitle: Share of children of who are enrolled in primary education amongst the total population of children of official primary school age.

title: Share of primary schools with access to the Internet for teaching
Prison population rate
subtitle: Number of prisoners, including pre-trial and remand detainees, per 100,000 people.

title: Private Civil Liberties Index
subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which people are free from forced labor, have property rights, and enjoy freedom of movement and religion. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most liberties).

title: Estimated funding raised by privately held AI companies
Probability of mismanaged plastic waste being emitted to the ocean
subtitle: Mismanaged plastic waste is plastic that is littered or thrown away improperly. It is not securely contained in a landfill or properly managed facility, so it can escape into the environment. This data captures how likely this waste is to be emitted into the ocean based on geographical factors such as distance to coastlines, river networks, topography and rainfall patterns.

title: Probability that a man will outlive a woman
subtitle: The chances that a man will outlive a woman, if both are selected randomly at birth, based on the age-specific death rates in a given year.

title: Productivity of small-scale food producers
subtitle: The value of agricultural output produced by small-scale food producers, per days worked in a year. Small-scale food producers are those in the bottom 40% of the amount of land used, livestock and revenues. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

title: Progress toward productive and sustainable agriculture
subtitle: Trend score describing a country's progress toward productive and sustainable agriculture.

title: Countries where guinea worm disease is endemic
subtitle: To be certified as free of guinea worm disease, a country must have reported zero indigenous cases through active surveillance for at least three consecutive years.

title: Progress towards polio eradication
subtitle: Countries with wild poliovirus transmission are considered endemic. Countries are shown as polio-free (not certified) if they have demonstrated the absence of wild poliovirus transmission. When all countries in a WHO region have recorded zero cases for three consecutive years while meeting surveillance targets, the region can be certified as polio-free.

title: Projected change in dependency ratio depending on labor force participation
subtitle:
– Age dependency is the ratio between people defined as dependents (under-15s and over-65s) and working-age people.
– Labor force dependency does not take into account age brackets but instead uses the ratio between those not participating in the workforce to those that are.
– High labor force participation assumes a higher share of people participating in the workforce (e.g. beyond the age of 65).

title: Local animal breeds with conserved genetic material
subtitle: The number of local animal breeds, those that exist in only one country, with sufficient genetic material stored within genebank collections to allow the reconstitution of the breed in case of extinction.

title: Proportion of children aged 3-5 years who are developmentally on track
subtitle: Children developmentally on-track in at least three of the following four domains: literacy-numeracy, physical, socio-emotional, and learning.

title: Forest certified for sustainable use
subtitle: The area of forest, measured in hectares, which has been certified for sustainable use by and independently verified forest certification scheme.

title: Share of forest with a long-term management plan
subtitle: A long-term forest management plan is the basis for the sustainable management of forest resources. An increasing area under a forest management plan indicates progress towards sustainable forest management.

title: Share of forest area within protected areas
subtitle: A protected area is a clearly defined geographical space, recognised, dedicated and managed to achieve the long-term conservation of nature with associated ecosystem services and cultural values.

title: Share of freshwater Key Biodiversity Areas that are protected
subtitle: The proportion of freshwater Key Biodiversity Areas (KBAs) which are covered by designated protected areas.

title: Proportion of local livestock breeds at risk of extinction
subtitle: Share of local livestock breeds which are classified as being at risk of extinction. Breed-related information remains far from complete. For almost 60 percent of all reported breeds, risk status is not known because of missing population data or lack of recent updates.

title: Share of population with access to basic handwashing facilities
subtitle: The percent of people who have access to basic handwashing facilities, including water and soap, at home.

title: Share of senior and middle management positions filled by women
subtitle: Women who are employed in decision-making and management roles in government, as well as large enterprises and institutions.

title: Share of products from least-developed countries that have no tariff
subtitle: Tariffs are import taxes applied to some products and can be used to create a price advantage for locally produced goods.

title: Share using safely managed drinking water
subtitle: Safely managed drinking water service means an improved water source is located on the premises, available when needed, and free from contamination.

title: Share of people who can use electronic presentation software
subtitle: Proportion of youth and adults aged 15 years and above who have skills in creating electronic presentations.

title: Protected area coverage of marine key biodiversity areas
subtitle: The average share of each marine Key Biodiversity Area (KBA) that is covered by designated protected areas.

title: Share of terrestrial Key Biodiversity Areas that are protected
subtitle: Proportion of terrestrial Key Biodiversity Areas (KBAs) that are covered by designated protected areas.

title: Protection of the rights of small-scale fisheries
subtitle: The implementation of frameworks which recognize and protect access rights for small-scale fisheries. The level of implemented protection is scored on a scale of 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).

title: Psychiatrists per 100,000 people
subtitle: The number of psychiatrists per 100,000 people in the population.

title: Government health spending as a share of GDP
subtitle: This metric captures spending on government funded health care systems and social health insurance, as well as compulsory health insurance.

title: Public health insurance coverage in Western Europe
subtitle: Share of the labor force covered by public health insurance in Western Europe.

title: Public morality laws on non-traditional sexual relations
subtitle: Policies banning "propaganda for non-traditional sexual relations" to discriminate against LGBT+ people in the name of protecting "public morality, particularly pertaining to children".

title: Public Sector Corruption Index
subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which public sector employees engage in bribery and theft. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (highly corrupt).

title: Public sector employment as a share of total employment
subtitle: Workers employed in central and sub-national government and public enterprises as a percentage of all workers.

title: Pupils per qualified teacher in primary education
subtitle: A qualified teacher is one who has the minimum academic qualifications necessary to teach at a primary level of education in a given country.

title: Passenger-kilometers by rail
subtitle: The number of passengers transported by rail, multiplied by the kilometers traveled. This is measured in passenger-kilometers.

title: Rate of new cervical cancer cases
subtitle: Estimated number of new cervical cancer cases per 100,000 people, in a given year.

title: Rate of new cervical cancer cases
Rate of premature deaths due to alcohol
subtitle: Estimated annual number of deaths attributed to alcohol use per 100,000 people.

title: Share of births that are twins
subtitle: The share of deliveries that are twins, reported by each country.

title: Progress towards the ratification and accession of UNCLOS
subtitle: Countries progress in ratifying and acceding United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and its two implementing agreements through legal, policy and institutional frameworks. Higher values indicate greater progress.

title: Ratio of female to male labor force participation rates
Literacy levels among young people, adjusted gender parity index
subtitle: An adjusted gender parity index of 1 indicates equality in literacy between men and women aged 15–24, defined as the ability to read and write a short, simple statement about everyday life with understanding. Values below 1 favor men, and above 1 favor women.

title: Annual GDP growth
subtitle: Annual percent change in gross domestic product. This data is adjusted for inflation.

title: Share of gross national income from poverty reduction grants
subtitle: Total official development assistance grants from all donors (i.e. Development Assistance Committee donors, multilateral organisations, and other bilateral providers of development cooperation) that focus on poverty reduction.

title: Red List Index
subtitle: The Red List Index shows trends in overall extinction risk for groups of species. It is an index between 0 and 1. A value of 1 indicates that there is no current extinction risk to any of the included species. A value of 0 would mean that all included species are extinct.

title: Reduction in income inequality before and after tax
subtitle: Percentage reduction in the Gini coefficient of income when measured after taxes and benefits, as compared to before taxes and benefits.

title: Refugees by country of asylum
subtitle: People who fled their country of origin because of serious threats against which the authorities of their home country cannot or will not protect them. This includes all refugees, not just those who arrived that year.

title: Refugees by country of origin
Registered vehicles per 1,000 people
Combating illegal fishing
subtitle: Progress by countries in the degree of implementation of international instruments aiming to combat illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing (where 1 is lowest; 5 is highest).

title: Relative increase in mean heights of females born in 1996 vs. 1896
subtitle: The relative change in mean height for adult women born in 1996 versus those born in 1896. This therefore represents the difference in mean height for women who reached their 18th birthday in 2014 relative to 1914.

title: Change in maternal mortality ratio
subtitle: Maternal mortality ratio is the estimated number of women who die from maternal conditions per 100,000 live births. This is given as the relative change in ratio from 1990 to 2015.

title: Relative increase in mean heights of men born in 1996 vs. 1896
subtitle: The relative change in mean height for adult men born in 1996 versus those born in 1896. This therefore represents the difference in mean height for men who reached their 18th birthday in 2014 relative to 1914.

title: Relative poverty: Share of population below 50% of the median
subtitle: Relative poverty is measured in terms of a poverty line that rises and falls over time with average incomes — in this case set at 50% of the median income or consumption.

title: Remittance costs as a proportion of the amount remitted
subtitle: The average remittance cost of sending $200 (or equivalent in local sending currency) from each country, expressed as a percentage.

title: Renewable electricity-generating capacity per person
subtitle: The installed capacity of power plants that generate electricity from renewable energy sources. This includes hydropower, marine (ocean, tidal and wave), wind, solar (photovoltaic and thermal energy), bioenergy, and geothermal energy.

title: Renewable freshwater resources per capita
subtitle: Renewable internal freshwater resources flows refer to internal renewable resources (internal river flows and groundwater from rainfall) in the country.

title: Replacement-level fertility rate
subtitle: The replacement-level fertility rate (the total fertility rate needed to keep the population size stable over time, without migration) is commonly stated to be 2.1. But the level can vary based on the sex ratio, child mortality rates, and other factors.

title: Reported cases of measles
Reported paralytic polio cases per million
subtitle: Annual number of reported cases of paralytic polio per million people. This includes all reported cases from wild polioviruses and vaccine-derived polioviruses.

title: Countries that have reported recent data on mental health
subtitle: Countries that have compiled and reported systematic data on mental health in the past two years, shown by the type of reporting.

title: Representation of women in the judiciary
subtitle: Share of judges that are women compared to women's share in the working-age population. Values lower than 1 indicate fewer women are judges than would be expected given their representation in the workforce, a value higher than 1 indicates more women than expected.

title: Representation of women in the upper chamber of parliament
subtitle: Share of women in the upper chamber of parliament compared to women's population share. Values lower than 1 indicate fewer women are parliamentarians than would be expected given their population share, a value higher than 1 indicates more women than expected.

title: Research & development spending as a share of GDP
subtitle: Includes basic research, applied research, and experimental development.

title: Number of R&D researchers per million people
subtitle: Professionals engaged in conceiving or creating new knowledge, products, processes, methods, or systems.

title: Resources to strengthen statistical capacity in developing countries
subtitle: The monetary value of all resources received to strengthen statistical capacity. This data is expressed in US dollars. It is not adjusted for inflation or differences in living costs between countries.

title: Respiratory infection death rate
subtitle: The reported annual death rate from respiratory infections per 100,000 people, based on the underlying cause listed on death certificates.

title: Revenue from corporate income taxes as a share of GDP
subtitle: Corporate income taxes include natural resources taxes.

title: Rice production
subtitle: Rice production is measured in tonnes.

title: Gender marker can be legally changed
subtitle: Possibility of changing one's gender in official national documents.

title: Rigorous and Impartial Public Administration Score
subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which public officials follow the law and show no favoritism or discrimination. Higher scores mean more rigor and impartiality. A score of 0 is approximately the average across all countries and years.

title: Share of people at risk of falling into poverty if payment for surgical care is required
subtitle: The proportion of population at risk of impoverishing expenditure when surgical care is required. Impoverishing expenditure is defined as direct out-of-pocket payments for surgical and anaesthesia care which drive people below the extreme poverty threshold.

title: Road accident deaths per billion passenger kilometers
subtitle: Number of deaths due to road accidents per billion passenger kilometers traveled on the road.

title: Share of road traffic deaths attributed to alcohol
subtitle: Share of all road traffic deaths attributed to alcohol consumption above the national legal limit for alcohol consumption. It includes deaths in vehicles, of pedestrians and of cyclists.

title: Number of one-year-olds who are not vaccinated against rotavirus
subtitle: Number of one-year-olds who haven't received the last dose of the rotavirus vaccine (RotaC).

title: Which countries include rotavirus vaccines in their national vaccination programs?
subtitle: This shows which countries provide and recommend rotavirus vaccines through routine services. People may still be able to receive the vaccine if it's not in the routine schedule – it might be optional or available commercially.

title: Rule of Law Index
subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which the government complies with the law, courts are independent, laws transparent, justice accessible, corruption absent, and the bureaucracy is impartial. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most rule-based).

title: People not using safely managed sanitation facilities
subtitle: People who do not use safely managed sanitation services might practice open defecation, use unimproved sanitation facilities, or use improved facilities that do not safely manage human waste.

title: Share that feel safe walking alone around the area they live at night
Change in sales of antibiotics for livestock
subtitle: Total sales of antimicrobials in non-tablet forms in tonnes of active ingredients; these are typically used in food-producing animals.

title: Sales of cigarettes per adult per day
subtitle: Daily sales of manufactured cigarettes to people aged 15 and over.

title: Same-sex sexual acts legal
subtitle: Law that same-sex sexual acts between consenting adults are criminalized or not.

title: Same-sex sexual acts legal
subtitle: Law that sexual acts between consenting same-sex adults in private are not criminalized. Some countries only criminalize sexual acts between men.

title: Annual articles published in scientific and technical journals per million people
subtitle: Includes physics, biology, chemistry, mathematics, clinical medicine, biomedical research, engineering and technology, and earth and space sciences.

title: Share of people agreeing with the statement "most people can be trusted"
Trade in services as share of GDP
subtitle: Total services trade (exports and imports) divided by gross domestic product (GDP).

title: Sex ratio at birth
subtitle: Number of boys born per 100 girls. Values above 100 mean more boys are born than girls. The biologically expected ratio at birth is around 105.

title: Sex ratio at age 5
subtitle: Number of boys per 100 girls at age 5. Values above 100 mean there are more boys than girls.

title: Share who agree vaccines are important for children to have
Share of artificial intelligence jobs among all job postings
Share of people who attend religious services frequently
subtitle: Share of respondents who say that they attend religious services "more than once a week", "once a week" or "once a month", apart from weddings, funerals and christenings.

title: Share of people who believe in climate change and think it's a serious threat to humanity
subtitle: Participants were asked to score beliefs on a scale from 0 to 100 on four questions: whether action was necessary to avoid a global catastrophe; humans were causing climate change; it was a serious threat to humanity; and was a global emergency.

title: Share of population that cannot afford a calorie sufficient diet
subtitle: The cost of an energy sufficient diet is the cheapest way that an individual can meet their calorie requirement using available staple foods in each country. A diet is defined as unaffordable when its cost, plus basic non-food needs like housing and transportation, exceeds daily income.

title: Share of cars currently in use that are electric
subtitle: Electric cars include fully battery-electric and plug-in hybrids.

title: Share of cereals allocated to human food
subtitle: Share of cereals available for domestic use – after accounting for trade – that is allocated to direct human consumption, relative to the total used for human food, animal feed, and industrial purposes. This excludes cereals used for seed, processing, and losses.

title: Share of cereals allocated to animal feed
subtitle: Share of cereals available for domestic use – after accounting for trade – that is allocated to animal feed, relative to the total used for human food, animal feed, and industrial purposes. This excludes cereals used for seed, processing, and losses.

title: Share of cereals allocated to industrial uses
subtitle: Share of cereals available for domestic consumption – after accounting for trade – that is allocated to other purposes (primarily industrial uses such as biofuel production), relative to the total allocated to human food, animal feed, and other uses. This excludes cereals used for seed, processing, and losses.

title: Share of CO₂ emissions embedded in trade
subtitle: Exported or imported emissions as a percentage of domestic production emissions. Positive values (red) represent net importers of CO₂. Negative values (blue) represent net exporters of CO₂.

title: Share covered by at least one social protection benefit
subtitle: The percentage of the population that either benefits from or contributes to at least one social protection scheme. This includes programs such as maternity benefits, unemployment benefits, and pensions.

title: Share of deaths caused by HIV/AIDS among all deaths
Share of deaths attributed to air pollution
subtitle: Share of deaths, from any cause, which are attributed to air pollution – from outdoor and indoor sources – as a risk factor.

title: Share of deaths from natural disasters
Share of deaths from indoor air pollution
subtitle: Share of deaths, from any cause, which are attributed to indoor air pollution – from burning solid fuels – as a risk factor.

title: Share of deaths attributed to outdoor air pollution
subtitle: Share of deaths, from any cause, where ambient particulate matter air pollution is a risk factor.

title: Share of deaths from secondhand smoke
subtitle: Estimated share of total deaths from any cause, where secondhand smoke was an attributed risk factor.

title: Share of deaths attributed to smoking
subtitle: The share of total deaths, from any cause, where smoking was an attributed risk factor.

title: Share of deaths from suicide
subtitle: Estimated share of deaths from suicide. Suicides are underreported in many countries due to social stigma and cultural or legal concerns. This data is based on modeling of global suicide patterns, and includes adjustments and extrapolations that aim to account for missing data and underreporting.

title: Share of deaths attributed to unsafe sanitation
subtitle: The share of total deaths, from any cause, with unsafe sanitation as an attributed risk factor

title: Share of deaths attributed to unsafe water sources
subtitle: The share of total deaths, from any cause, with unsafe water sources as an attributed risk factor.

title: Share of land that is degraded
subtitle: Land degradation is defined as the reduction or loss of the biological or economic productivity of land resulting from a combination of pressures, including land use and management practices.

title: Share that disagrees that vaccines are safe
subtitle: The share of respondents who responded "strongly disagree" or "somewhat disagree" to the statement 'Vaccines are safe.'

title: Share that disagrees that vaccines are effective
subtitle: The share of people who responded "strongly disagree" or "somewhat disagree" to the statement 'Vaccines are effective'.

title: Share of people in European countries using generative AI tools
subtitle: Share of individuals aged 16 to 74 who reported using generative AI tools in the previous three months.

title: Share of firms with a female top manager
subtitle: Top manager refers to the highest ranking manager or CEO of the establishment. This may be the owner if she works as the manager of the firm.

title: Share of food products in total merchandise exports
subtitle: Value of food exports divided by the total value of merchandise exports, expressed as a percentage.

title: Share of foreign aid received that is climate-related
subtitle: Committed bilateral official development assistance (ODA) that targets climate change mitigation, adaptation, or both, as a share of the bilateral ODA received that is covered by the OECD's climate tracking.

title: Share of global excess nitrogen from croplands
subtitle: "Excess nitrogen" is the difference between nutrient inputs (from fertilizers, manure, and fixation from legumes) and the amount harvested in crop material. This represents nitrogen that is lost to the environment and can create ecological imbalances in ecosystems and water bodies.

title: Share of global excess phosphorus from croplands
subtitle: "Excess phosphorus" is the difference between nutrient inputs (from fertilizers and manure) and the amount harvested in crop material. This represents phosphorus that is lost to the environment and can create ecological imbalances on ecosystems and in water bodies.

title: Share of global forest area
Share of women graduating from STEM programs in tertiary education
subtitle: Proportion of female graduates in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) fields at the tertiary level of education.

title: Share of population that cannot afford a healthy diet
subtitle: The cost of a healthy diet is the lowest-cost set of foods available that would meet requirements in dietary guidelines from governments and public health agencies. A diet is defined as unaffordable when its cost, plus basic non-food needs like housing and transportation, exceeds daily income.

title: Share of workers in informal employment
Share of female workers in informal employment
Share of workers in vulnerable employment
Poverty: Share of population living on less than $10 a day
subtitle: This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

title: Poverty: Share of population living on less than $8.30 a day
subtitle: The poverty line of $8.30 per day is set by the World Bank to be representative of the definitions of poverty adopted in upper-middle-income countries. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

title: Share of manufactured products in total merchandise exports
subtitle: Value of manufacture exports divided by the total value of merchandise exports, expressed as a percentage.

title: Share of population living in multidimensional poverty
subtitle: Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived in a range of health, education and living standards indicators.

title: Share of adults who are obese
subtitle: Obesity is defined here as a body mass index (BMI) above 30. BMI is a person's weight in kilograms divided by the square of their height in meters.

title: Share of adults who are overweight or obese
subtitle: Overweight is defined here as a body mass index (BMI) above 25. BMI is a person's weight in kilograms divided by the square of their height in meters.

title: Share of adults who drank alcohol in last year
subtitle: Adults are defined as those aged 15 years and older. Shown is the share of adults who have drunk any alcohol in the preceding 12 months.

title: Share of adults who perceive their rights to land as secure
subtitle: The landholder is considered to perceive their land rights as secure if they both: i) do not report a fear of involuntary loss of the land within the next five years, and ii) report having the right to bequeath the land.

title: Share of adults who smoke or use other tobacco
subtitle: Estimated percentage of people aged 15 and older who currently use tobacco. This includes all forms of tobacco use, such as smoking, chewing or snuffing, but excludes products that do not contain tobacco, such as e-cigarettes.

title: Share of agricultural land being productively and sustainably used
subtitle: The share of a country's agricultural land that is considered to be both productive and sustainable when assessed against 11 sub-indicators across three dimensions: economic, environmental, and social.

title: Share of agricultural landowners who are women
subtitle: Share of population with secure tenure rights over land that are women. Secure tenure rights over land include agricultural land ownership and the right to sell or bequeath agricultural land.

title: Share of children who were born outside of marriage
subtitle: Share of all children born to mothers who were not married at the time of birth.

title: Share of cancer deaths attributed to tobacco use
subtitle: Share of total cancer deaths attributed to tobacco, which is inclusive of smoking, chewing tobacco and secondhand smoke.

title: Share of central government spending funded by taxes
Share of children achieving minimum reading proficiency by the end of primary education age
Share of one-year-olds vaccinated against diphtheria, tetanus and pertussis
subtitle: Share of one-year-olds who received all three recommended doses of the combined diphtheria, tetanus and pertussis vaccine (DTP3).

title: Share of children achieving minimum reading proficiency by the end of lower-secondary age
Share of one-year-olds vaccinated against measles
subtitle: Share of one-year-olds who have received the first dose of the measles vaccine (MCV1).

title: Share of children fully vaccinated against measles
subtitle: Share of children who have received the second and final dose of the measles vaccine (MCV2).

title: Share of children who are overweight
subtitle: Percentage of children under five years old who are defined as overweight (weight-for-height more than two standard deviations from the median of the World Health Organization's child growth standards).

title: Share of children who experienced violence
subtitle: Children aged 1-14 years who experienced physical punishment and/or psychological aggression by caregivers in the last month.

title: Malnutrition: Share of children who are wasted
subtitle: The share of children younger than five years old that are defined as "wasted". Wasting is when a child’s weight is significantly lower than the average for their height, for example, because of acute food shortage or disease.

title: Share of children with diarrhea receiving treatment
subtitle: The share of children under five years old with diarrhea, in the two weeks prior to the survey, who received either oral rehydration therapy or increased fluids, whilst feeding continues.

title: Malnutrition: Share of children who are stunted
subtitle: Share of children younger than five years old who are defined as stunted. Stunting is when a child is significantly shorter than the average for their age. It is a consequence of poor nutrition or repeated infection.

title: Share of city residents with convenient access to public transport
subtitle: Share of people in cities who live within walking distance of a public transport stop.

title: Share of consumer expenditure spent on food
subtitle: Food expenditure only includes food bought for consumption at home. Out-of-home food purchases, alcohol, and tobacco are not included.

title: Share of global cumulative CO₂ emissions
subtitle: Cumulative emissions are the running sum of annual emissions since 1750. This measures fossil fuel and industry emissions. Land-use change emissions are not included.

title: Time per day women spend on unpaid domestic and care work
subtitle: Average hours per day that women aged 15 and older spend on unpaid domestic and care work.

title: Share of deaths for which the cause is registered
subtitle: Share of deaths registered with an underlying cause of death in a country's vital registration system. The total number of deaths is estimated using household surveys and censuses.

title: Share of deaths from homicide
subtitle: The percentage of annual deaths which are homicides.

title: Share of deaths from opioid use disorders
subtitle: Estimated annual share of deaths from opioid use disorders.

title: Share of deaths from terrorism
subtitle: Confirmed deaths, including all victims and attackers who died because of a terrorist attack as a share of total deaths within each country.

title: Share of deaths attributed to obesity
subtitle: Obesity is defined as having a body-mass index (BMI) equal to or greater than 30. BMI is a person's weight in kilograms divided by their height in meters squared. Shown is the share of total deaths, from any cause, with obesity as an attributed risk factor.

title: Share of deaths that are registered
subtitle: Deaths reported in a country's vital registration system as a share of total expected deaths.

title: Share of E. coli infections resistant to cephalosporins
subtitle: Cephalosporins are a class of antibiotics commonly used to treat E. coli infections. This shows the estimated share of infections by E. coli in the bloodstream that were resistant to 3rd generation cephalosporins.

title: Employee compensation as share of government spending
subtitle: Employee compensation includes wages, in-kind payments, and government contributions to social insurance schemes such as social security and pensions.

title: Share of employment in agriculture
subtitle: Agriculture includes the cultivation of crops and livestock production, as well as forestry, hunting, and fishing. Employment includes anyone engaged in any activity to produce goods or services for pay or profit.

title: Share of women who are overweight or obese
subtitle: A person is defined as overweight if they have a body-mass index (BMI) equal to or greater than 25. BMI is a person's weight in kilograms divided by his height in meters squared.

title: Share of final energy use that comes from renewable sources
subtitle: Renewable energy includes solar, wind, geothermal, hydropower, bioenergy, and marine sources.

title: Share of firms that say corruption is a big problem for them
subtitle: Share of firms that say corruption is a "major" or "very severe" problem for their operations.

title: Share of fish stocks within sustainable levels
subtitle: Fish stocks are classified as "within biologically sustainable levels" if their abundance is estimated to be equal to or greater than the level that can produce the Maximum Sustainable Yield (MSY).

title: Share of global habitable land needed for agriculture if everyone had the diet of...
subtitle: The percentage of global habitable land area needed for agriculture if the total world population was to adopt the average diet of any given country. Values greater than 100% are not possible within global land constraints.

title: Share of global mismanaged plastic waste
subtitle: Mismanaged plastic waste is waste that is not recycled, incinerated, or kept in sealed landfills. It includes materials burned in open pits, dumped into seas or open waters, or disposed of in unsanitary landfills and dumpsites.

title: Share of global plastic waste emitted to the ocean
subtitle: Annual estimate of plastic emissions. A country's total does not include waste that is exported overseas, which may be at higher risk of entering the ocean.

title: Share of global services exports
subtitle: The share of global services exports represents a country’s contribution to the total worldwide exports of services, such as financial services, IT, tourism, and consulting. It indicates how competitive and influential a country is in the global services market compared to others.

title: Share of government spending going to interest payments
subtitle: Interest expenditures on government debt, as share of total central government expenditures. Interest expenditures on government debt include payments on long-term bonds, long-term loans, and other debt instruments.

title: Share of health facilities with essential medicines
subtitle: Proportion of health facilities that have quality-assured medicines that are available and affordable relative to the total number of surveyed health facilities at national level.

title: Share of households consuming iodized salt
Share of the population using the Internet
subtitle: Share of the population who used the Internet in the last three months.

title: Share of industrial wastewater flows that are treated
subtitle: Industrial wastewater is includes wastewater generated from mining, manufacturing, construction and the production and distribution of electricity.

title: Share of land area used for agriculture
subtitle: The share of land area used for agriculture, measured as a percentage of total land area. Agricultural land refers to the share of land area that is arable, under permanent crops, and under permanent pastures.

title: Share of land area used for arable agriculture
subtitle: The share of land area used for arable agriculture, measured as a percentage of total land area. Arable land includes land defined by the FAO as land under temporary crops (double-cropped areas are counted once), temporary meadows for mowing or for pasture, land under market or kitchen gardens, and land temporarily fallow.

title: Share of land covered by lakes and rivers
subtitle: The percentage of total land area that is made up of lakes and rivers all year round.

title: Share of babies born with a low birthweight
subtitle: Estimated percentage of newborn babies that weigh under 2.5kg. These babies are more likely to suffer poor health and stunted growth.

title: Share of women whose family planning needs are met
subtitle: The proportion of women aged 15-49 years who are currently using at least one modern contraceptive method, out of the total population of women who want to postpone their next pregnancy or have no more children.

title: Share of men who smoke or use other tobacco
subtitle: Estimated percentage of men aged 15 and older who currently use tobacco. This includes all forms of tobacco use, such as smoking, chewing or snuffing, but excludes products that do not contain tobacco, such as e-cigarettes.

title: Share of mothers visited by a health professional during pregnancy
subtitle: The estimated share of women who have had a live birth who were visited at least once during pregnancy by a skilled health personnel for reasons related to pregnancy.

title: Share of mothers who have lost a child under five
subtitle: The reported or estimated share of mothers who have experienced the death of a child under five years old, among mothers aged 20–44 years old.

title: Share of mountain land that is degraded
subtitle: Degraded land is land that has lost biological or economic productivity and complexity due to pressures from land use or management practices.

title: Share of new cancers caused by all known infectious agents
subtitle: Estimated share of new cancer cases attributed to all known cancer-causing pathogens. Estimates come with uncertainties, especially for countries that lack cancer registries or have limited pathogen testing.

title: Share of new cancers caused by Helicobacter pylori bacteria
subtitle: The estimated share of all new cancer cases that are attributed to the bacterium Helicobacter pylori. The bacteria can infect the stomach lining and is a key risk factor for the development of certain types of stomach cancer.

title: Share of one-year-olds vaccinated against Streptococcus pneumoniae
subtitle: Share of one-year-olds who have had the final recommended dose (2nd or 3rd) of the pneumococcal conjugate vaccine in a given year.

title: Share of one-year-olds vaccinated against rotavirus
subtitle: The share of one-year-old children who received the final recommended dose of rotavirus vaccine.

title: Share of out-of-pocket spending on healthcare
subtitle: Out-of-pocket spending on healthcare as percent of total current healthcare expenditure.

title: Share of people saying they do not want homosexual neighbors
subtitle: Share of survey respondents stating that they do not want homosexual neighbors.

title: Share of people who find political decision-making inclusive and responsive
subtitle: Share of people who responded that the political system in their country allows people like them to have a say in what the government does and to have an influence on politics.

title: Share of people who say accepting a bribe is never justifiable
subtitle: Share of people who said accepting a bribe is "never justifiable" (score of 1), when asked to rate how acceptable bribery is on a scale from 1 to 10 ("always justifiable").

title: Share of people who say they are happy
subtitle: Share of people who respond they are "very happy" or "rather happy" to the question "Taking all things together, would you say you are … ?"

title: Share of people who say they are satisfied with their life
subtitle: Share of people answering "very satisfied" or "fairly satisfied" to the question "On the whole, are you very satisfied, fairly satisfied, not very satisfied, or not at all satisfied with the life you lead?"

title: Share of people who think homosexuality is never or rarely justified
subtitle: Share of survey respondents stating that homosexuality can never or rarely be justified.

title: Share of people worried about terrorism
subtitle: Respondents who said they worried "very much" or "a great deal".

title: Share of population living in extreme poverty
subtitle: Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line of $3 per day. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

title: Share of population living in severe multidimensional poverty
subtitle: Severe multidimensional poverty is defined as being highly deprived in a range of health, education and living standards indicators.

title: Share of population living below national poverty lines
subtitle: National poverty headcount ratio is the percentage of the population living below the national poverty lines. National estimates are based on population-weighted subgroup estimates from household surveys.

title: Share of population living in the capital city
subtitle: Estimated share of the population living in the capital city. City boundaries are defined using a consistent global approach based on satellite imagery and population data.

title: Share of population living in urban areas
subtitle: Share of the population living in urban areas, based on each country's national definition.

title: Share of population who haver never drunk alcohol
subtitle: Lifetime abstinence is defined as the proportion of adults (15+ years) in a given population who have not consumed any alcohol during their lifetime.

title: Share of population with cancer
subtitle: The estimated share of population with any form of cancer.

title: Share of the population using at least basic sanitation services
subtitle: Basic sanitation services are defined as improved sanitation facilities, such as toilets or latrines, which are not shared with other households.

title: Share of population with large expenditures on health
subtitle: The share of the population that spend more than 10% of total household expenditure or income on health.

title: Share of population with moderate or severe food insecurity
subtitle: Food insecurity is defined by the Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES). Moderate food insecurity is associated with the inability to regularly eat healthy, nutritious diets. Severe food insecurity is more related to insufficient quantity of food (energy).

title: Share of population with severe food insecurity
subtitle: Someone suffering from severe food insecurity has an insufficient quantity of food. They will experience symptoms such as physical hunger.

title: Share of S. aureus infections resistant to methicillin
subtitle: Methicillin is an antibiotic commonly used to treat infections by Staphylococcus aureus. This shows the estimated share of infections by S. aureus in the bloodstream that were resistant to methicillin.

title: Share of services in total exports
subtitle: Services refer to economic output of intangible commodities that may be produced, transferred, and consumed at the same time. The share of services in total exports comes from comparing trade in goods and services at current US dollars.

title: Share of single-parent households
subtitle: Percentage of households comprised of a single parent and their children (biological, step, adopted, or fostered) and no one else, irrespective of children’s ages.

title: Share of small arms and light weapons with illicit origin
subtitle: Seized, found, or surrendered arms whose illicit origin or context has been traced or established. Small arms and light weapons include easily transportable weapons such as handguns and light machine guns.

title: Share of students achieving minimum reading proficiency by the end of primary education
Share of the daily calorie supply that comes from animal protein
Share of the population at risk of catastrophic spending  when surgical care is required
subtitle: Catastrophic expenditure is defined as direct out-of-pocket payments for surgical and anaesthesia care exceeding 10% of total income.

title: Share of the population living with HIV
subtitle: Estimated share of the population aged 15–49 living with HIV.

title: Share of the population living with HIV/AIDS
subtitle: Estimated share of the total population with HIV/AIDS.

title: Share of adults reporting having felt discriminated against
subtitle: Adults reporting having experienced discrimination or harassment during the last year, based on grounds prohibited by international human rights law.

title: Share of the population using improved sanitation facilities
subtitle: Improved sanitation facilities are those designed to hygienically separate excreta from human contact and include flush/pour flush toilets connected to piped sewer systems, septic tanks, pit latrines, and composting toilets.

title: Share of the population using improved water sources
subtitle: Improved drinking water sources are designed to deliver safe water and include piped water, boreholes or tubewells, protected dug wells, protected springs, rainwater, and packaged or delivered water.

title: Share of the population with post-secondary education or higher
Share of the population with access to electricity
Historical basic numeracy rates
subtitle: Historic basic numeracy is assessed through age heaping—when people round their age to numbers like 30 or 35—by comparing how often this happens to how often it would in a uniform age distribution.

title: Share of the population estimated to have prior infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis
subtitle: The estimated share of the population who have been previously infected by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. In a fraction of this population, the bacteria can reactivate and cause tuberculosis, months or years later. Estimates come with wide uncertainties due to limited testing for prior infection.

title: Share of the total land area burnt by wildfires each year
Share of urban population living in inadequate housing
subtitle: For housing to be adequate it must fulfill all the following criteria: legal security of tenure, availability of facilities and infrastructure (e.g. sanitation, clean water and energy for heating and cooking), affordability, habitability, accessibility, suitable location and cultural adequacy.

title: Share of urban population living in slums
subtitle: A slum household is defined as a group of individuals living under the same roof lacking one or more of the following conditions: access to improved water and sanitation, sufficient living area, housing durability, and security of tenure.

title: Share of women aged 15–49 who are married or in a union
subtitle: Percentage of women who are married, or who live with a partner without being married.

title: What share of the population living with HIV are women?
subtitle: Among those aged 15 years and older.

title: Share of women in local government
subtitle: Local governments, such as councils or assemblies, often have decision-making power over local public affairs. Only elected seats are considered.

title: Share of women in ministerial positions
subtitle: Deputy prime ministers and prime ministers or heads of government that hold ministerial portfolios are included, vice-presidents and heads of governmental or public agencies are excluded.

title: Share of women in parliament
subtitle: Percentage of seats in lower or single chamber of the legislature held by women.

title: Share of women using modern contraceptive methods
subtitle: Estimated share of women using modern contraceptive methods, among those aged 15–49 and married or in union.

title: Share of women who smoke or use other tobacco
subtitle: Estimated percentage of women aged 15 and older who currently use tobacco. This includes all forms of tobacco use, such as smoking, chewing or snuffing, but excludes products that do not contain tobacco, such as e-cigarettes.

title: Share of women who experienced violence from an intimate partner
subtitle: Ever-partnered women aged over 15 years who have been subject to physical or sexual violence by a current or former intimate partner in the last 12 months. An ever-partnered woman is a woman who has had an intimate partner at any time in their life.

title: Share of working children who do not attend school
subtitle: Share of children ages 7-14 working at least 1 hour per week and not attending school, as a share of all children working at least 1 hour per week.

title: Share of young people in European countries using generative AI tools
subtitle: Share of individuals aged 16 to 24 who reported using generative AI tools in the previous three months.

title: Share of people who completed the initial COVID-19 vaccination protocol
subtitle: Total number of people who received all doses prescribed by the initial vaccination protocol, divided by the total population of the country.

title: Share in multidimensional poverty according to national definitions
subtitle: This data is not comparable across countries, as national definitions of multidimensional poverty vary widely. Included dimensions can be e.g. health, education and living standards.

title: Share of people who trust journalists in their country
subtitle: Share of respondents who answered "a lot" or "some" to the question: "How much do you trust journalists in your country?"

title: Share of people who received at least one dose of COVID-19 vaccine
subtitle: Total number of people who received at least one vaccine dose, divided by the total population of the country.

title: Share of the population that is female
Share of the population that owns a mobile phone
subtitle: Share of the population that has a mobile phone device with at least one active SIM card for personal use.

title: Share of people who pray frequently
subtitle: The share of survey respondents who say they pray at least several times a week, apart from weddings and funerals.

title: Social protection spending as share of total government spending
subtitle: Social protection includes the following main areas: sickness, disability, pensions, housing, unemployment, family and children.

title: Share of population using safely managed sanitation
subtitle: Safely managed sanitation are improved sanitation facilities that are not shared with other households and where excreta are safely disposed in situ or transported and treated off-site.

title: Share of total municipal solid waste that is collected
Share of adults who have not drunk alcohol in the last year
subtitle: Adults are defined as those aged 15 years and older. Shown is the share of adults who have not drunk any alcohol in the preceding 12 months.

title: Share who report lifetime anxiety or depression
subtitle: Respondents were asked 'Have you ever been so anxious or depressed that you could not continue your regular daily activities as you normally would for two weeks or longer?'

title: Share of people in range of 4G mobile network
Share of population with an alcohol use disorder
subtitle: Alcohol dependence is defined by the International Classification of Diseases as the presence of three or more indicators of dependence for at least a month within the previous year.

title: Share of population with drug use disorders
subtitle: Drug dependence is defined by the International Classification of Diseases as the presence of three or more indicators of dependence for at least a month within the previous year. Drug dependency includes all illicit drugs and excludes alcohol and tobacco.

title: Share of population with mental health disorders
subtitle: This includes depression, anxiety, bipolar, eating disorders, and schizophrenia.

title: Share of population not using improved sanitation facilities
Share of population not using improved drinking water sources
subtitle: Improved drinking water sources are those that can deliver safe water. They include piped water, boreholes or tube wells, protected dug wells, protected springs, rainwater, and packaged or delivered water.

title: Share of small-scale manufacturing in total manufacturing
subtitle: Proportion of value added by small-scale manufacturing industries in total value added by manufacturing.

title: Share of small-scale industries with a loan or line of credit
Public social spending as share of GDP
subtitle: Social spending includes, among others, the following areas: health, old age, incapacity-related benefits, family, active labor market programmes, unemployment, and housing.

title: Southern white rhino population
subtitle: Estimated number of southern white rhinos.

title: Sovereign state
subtitle: Sovereign states as identified by Butcher and Griffiths (2020). Only countries that are independent today are shown in the map. Current country borders are used across time.

title: Sovereign state
subtitle: Sovereign states as identified by Correlates of War (2017). Only countries that are independent today are shown in the map. Current country borders are used across time.

title: Sovereign state
subtitle: Sovereign states as identified by Gleditsch and Ward (2007). Only countries that are independent today are shown in the map. Current country borders are used across time.

title: Soybean production
subtitle: Soybean production is measured in tonnes.

title: Soybean yields
subtitle: Yields are measured in tonnes per hectare.

title: Spirits as a share of total alcohol consumption
subtitle: Spirits as a share of total alcohol consumption by adults aged over 15, as measured in terms of litres of pure alcohol.

title: Spirits consumption per person
subtitle:
Spirit consumption per person, measured in liters of pure alcohol per year.
Spirits are distilled alcoholic drinks and include gin, rum, whisky, tequila and vodka.

title: Standard alcoholic drink measure
subtitle: Standard alcohol drink measures are given as the grams of alcohol per unit.

title: State Capacity Index
subtitle: The index captures the extent to which the state controls its territory, sustainably raises sufficient resources, and has skilled and impartial security forces and public servants. Higher scores mean more capacity.

title: States involved in interstate conflicts
subtitle: Included are states that participated in at least one conflict with another state where force was threatened, displayed, or used that year.

title: Countries where trachoma is a public health problem
subtitle: Progress towards trachoma's elimination as a public health problem. Trachoma is a bacterial eye infection and is a major infectious cause of blindness.

title: Countries where yaws is endemic
subtitle: Yaws is a debilitating bacterial disease that can be treated with inexpensive antibiotics. The disease was first targeted for eradication in the 1950s.

title: Stomach cancer death rate
subtitle: Reported deaths from stomach cancer per 100,000 people, based on the underlying cause listed on death certificates.

title: Death rate from stroke
subtitle: Estimated annual death rate from stroke, per 100,000 people.

title: Share of adult citizens who have the right to vote
subtitle: Share of adult citizens who have the legal right to vote in national elections.

title: Sugar cane production
subtitle: Sugar cane production is measured in tonnes.

title: Suicide rate
subtitle: Estimated annual number of suicides per 100,000 people. Suicide deaths are underreported in many countries due to social stigma and cultural or legal concerns. This data is based on modeling of global suicide patterns, and includes adjustments and extrapolations that aim to account for missing data and underreporting.

title: Reported suicide rates
subtitle: Reported annual death rate from suicide per 100,000 people. Suicide deaths are underreported in many countries due to social stigma and cultural or legal concerns. This data has not been adjusted for underreporting, and comparisons may be affected by differences in measurement.

title: Sumatran rhino population
subtitle: Number of Sumatran rhinos (officially named 'Dicerorhinus sumatrensis').

title: Share of people who support policies to tackle climate change
subtitle: Support was measured on a scale from 0 to 100 across nine interventions, including carbon taxes on fossil fuels, expanding public transport, more renewable energy, more electric car chargers, taxes on airlines, investments in green jobs and businesses, laws to keep waterways clean, protecting forests, and increasing taxes on carbon-intensive foods.

title: Share of people who say their government should do more to tackle climate change
subtitle: Based on representative surveys of almost 130,000 people across 125 countries. Participants were asked: "Do you think the national government should do more to fight global warming?"

title: Share that think people in their country should act to tackle climate change
subtitle: Based on representative surveys of almost 130,000 people across 125 countries. Participants were asked: "Do you think that people in [their country] should try to fight global warming?"

title: Support to help quit smoking
Specialist surgical workforce rate
subtitle: Specialist surgical workforce is the number of specialist surgical, anaesthetic, and obstetric (SAO) providers who are working in each country per 100,000 population.

title: Sustainable fisheries as a proportion of gross domestic product
subtitle: The value added of sustainable marine capture fisheries as a proportion of GDP.

title: Tax revenue as share of GDP
subtitle: Direct and indirect taxes as well as social contributions included.

title: Taxes as a share of cigarette price
Taxes on goods and services as share of GDP
subtitle: Tax revenue on goods and services (including sales taxes, value added taxes and excise duties) divided by gross domestic product, expressed as a percentage.

title: Taxes on incomes of individuals and corporations as share of GDP
subtitle: Tax revenue on incomes, profits and capital gains divided by gross domestic product, expressed as a percentage.

title: Tuberculosis patients living with HIV receiving antiretroviral therapy
subtitle: The estimated number of people with tuberculosis and HIV, who are receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART).

title: Tuberculosis patients who tested positive for HIV
subtitle: Estimated number of patients diagnosed with tuberculosis who have tested positive for HIV. Numbers are limited by testing capacity.

title: Tuberculosis-related deaths among people living with HIV
subtitle: Estimated number of tuberculosis-related deaths among people living with HIV.

title: Share of land area that is protected
subtitle: Terrestrial protected areas are areas of at least 1,000 hectares that are designated by national authorities in order to preserve their ecosystem services and cultural values.

title: Terrorism deaths
subtitle: Confirmed deaths, including all victims and attackers who died because of a terrorist attack.

title: Number of terrorist attacks
subtitle: Number of terrorist attacks.

title: Tests conducted per new confirmed case of COVID-19
subtitle: 7-day rolling average. Comparisons across countries are affected by differences in testing policies and reporting methods.

title: Tetanus death rate
subtitle: The number of deaths from tetanus per 100,000 individuals. This rate is age-standardized, keeping the population structure constant to allow for comparisons between countries and over time.

title: The decade of the last recorded wild paralytic polio case
subtitle: Countries are considered endemic if they have indigenous cases of polio from wild polioviruses.

title: Number of new tetanus infections by world region
subtitle: The estimated number of new cases of tetanus each year.

title: Reported cases of paralytic polio
subtitle: Annual reported cases of polio that led to paralysis of the infected person. It includes both wild- and vaccine-derived polioviruses.

title: Reported cases of paralytic polio by world region
subtitle: This includes all reported cases from wild polioviruses and vaccine-derived polioviruses.

title: Share of neonates protected at birth against neonatal tetanus
Third gender legally recognized
subtitle: Another gender alongside "man" and "woman" is recognized by law.

title: Corruption Perceptions Index
subtitle: Average score across 13 expert and business surveys on the extent of corruption in the public sector. The index ranges from 0 to 100 (least corrupt).

title: Tomato production
subtitle: Tomato production is measured in tonnes.

title: Agricultural land use per person
subtitle: This dataset is showing estimates of the total agricultural land area – which is the combination of cropland and grazing land – per person. It is measured in hectares per person.

title: Alcohol consumption per person
subtitle: Estimated consumption of alcohol is measured in liters of pure alcohol per person aged 15 or older, per year.

title: Total financial assistance and flows for agriculture, by recipient
subtitle: Total official development assistance and other official flows from all donors to the agriculture sector. This data is expressed in US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.

title: Greenhouse gas emissions
subtitle: Greenhouse gas emissions include carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide from all sources, including land-use change. They are measured in tonnes of carbon dioxide-equivalents over a 100-year timescale.

title: Government spending per capita
subtitle: Total spending across all levels of government. Includes intermediate consumption, compensation of employees, subsidies, property income, social benefits, and capital transfers and investments. This data is adjusted for differences in living costs between countries but not for inflation.

title: Total healthcare spending as a share of GDP
subtitle: Total healthcare expenditure as the share of national gross domestic product (GDP).

title: Share of medium and high-tech manufacturing in gross domestic product
subtitle:
Proportion of medium and high-tech manufacturing (MHT) value added as a share of total GDP.
MHT includes manufacturing of various products, such as chemicals, electronics, machinery, vehicles and similar.

title: Cumulative RCTs published in high-ranked medical journals
subtitle: All randomized controlled trials (RCTs) ever published in high-ranked medical journals. This includes primary analyses, secondary analyses and methods papers describing RCTs.

title: Total official flows commitments for aid for trade, by donor
subtitle: Gross disbursements and commitments of total Official Development Assistance (ODA) from all donors for aid for trade. This data is expressed in US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.

title: Total official flows commitments for aid for trade, by recipient
subtitle: Gross disbursements and commitments of total Official Development Assistance from all donors for aid for trade. This data is expressed in US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.

title: Total amount donated for biodiversity conservation in developing countries
subtitle: Total official development assistance transferred for use in biodiversity conservation and protection efforts, by donor. This data is expressed in constant US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.

title: Total donations received for biodiversity conservation
subtitle: Total official development assistance (ODA) transferred for use in biodiversity conservation and protection efforts, by recipient. This data is expressed in constant US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.

title: International financial support to infrastructure
subtitle: Total official international support (official development assistance plus other official flows) to infrastructure. This data is expressed in US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.

title: Total official financial flows for water supply and sanitation, by recipient
subtitle: Total water and sanitation-related Official Development Assistance disbursements that are included in the government budget. This data is expressed in US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.

title: Total official development assistance for technical co-operation
subtitle: Technical co-operation official development assistance includes grants for education or training, and payments to consultants and similar personnel as well as teachers and administrators serving in recipient countries. This data is expressed in US dollars. It is adjusted for inflation but does not account for differences in living costs between countries.

title: Number of people living in extreme poverty
subtitle: Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line of $3 per day. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

title: Tourism contribution to GDP
Number of people with trachoma per 100,000
subtitle: Estimated number of people living with trachoma, per 100,000 people in the population. Trachoma is a bacterial eye infection and is a major infectious cause of blindness.

title: Trade as a share of GDP
subtitle: Sum of exports and imports of goods and services, divided by gross domestic product, expressed as a percentage. This is also known as the "trade openness index".

title: Historical trade openness in Europe
subtitle: Sum of exports and imports of goods and services, divided by gross domestic product (GDP), expressed as a percentage. This is also known as the "trade openness index".

title: Energy embedded in traded goods as a share of domestic energy
subtitle: Net energy embedded in traded goods is the difference in energy embedded in exported goods, and imported goods. A positive value means that a country is a net importer; a negative means it's a net exporter. This is given as a percentage of a country's domestic energy use.

title: Tree cover loss
subtitle: Estimated area of tree cover loss. Tree cover loss is the temporary or permanent loss of vegetation greater than five meters in height.

title: Tree cover loss from wildfires
Share of people who say they trust people of another religion
subtitle: The share of survey respondents who say they trust people who follow a different religion to them.

title: Share of people who trust churches and religious organizations
subtitle: The share of survey respondents who say they trust religious organizations such as churches, mosques and temples.

title: Tuberculosis case detection rate
subtitle: Estimated share of tuberculosis cases in a country that were actually diagnosed and treated in national tuberculosis control programs. The WHO estimates the true number of cases based on a range of additional sources such as smaller-scale surveys, expert opinion and statistical modeling which gives them a correction factor that adjusts for underreporting.

title: Tuberculosis case fatality rate
subtitle: The estimated share of people who die from tuberculosis, out of those diagnosed.

title: Tuberculosis death rate
subtitle: Estimated annual number of deaths from all forms of tuberculosis per 100,000 people.

title: Tuberculosis death rate
subtitle: Estimated number of age-standardized deaths from tuberculosis, per 100,000 people.

title: Tuberculosis death rate
subtitle: The estimated death rate from tuberculosis per 100,000 people.

title: Tuberculosis deaths in children under five
subtitle: Estimated annual number of deaths from tuberculosis in children under five years old. Estimates come with wide uncertainties especially for countries with poor vital registration.

title: Tuberculosis deaths
subtitle: Estimated deaths from all forms of tuberculosis.

title: Share of tuberculosis patients with HIV
subtitle: The estimated share of people with tuberculosis who also have HIV.

title: Unemployment rate
Youth unemployment rate
Female unemployment rate
United Nations membership status
The Universal Health Coverage (UHC) Service Coverage Index
subtitle: The Universal Health Coverage (UHC) Service Coverage Index is measured on a scale from 0 (worst) to 100 (best) based on the average coverage of essential services including reproductive, maternal, newborn and child health, infectious diseases, non-communicable diseases and service capacity and access.

title: Universal right to vote in practice
subtitle: "In practice" means that people get to exercise the right because the parliament and government are actually elected.

title: Universal right to vote
subtitle: This does not consider elections not being held, informal restrictions, or legal restrictions based on age, criminal conviction, disability, and local residency.

title: Women's universal right to vote
subtitle: This does not consider elections not being held, informal restrictions, or legal restrictions based on age, criminal conviction, disability, and local residency.

title: Unmet need for contraception among married women of reproductive age
subtitle: Fertile, married women of reproductive age (ages 15-49) who do not want to become pregnant and are not using contraception.

title: Unsentenced detainees as a proportion of overall prison population
subtitle: People held in detention who have not yet been sentenced as a percentage of all people held in detention.

title: Upper secondary completion rate, adjusted gender parity index
Share of population living in cities with more than 1 million residents
subtitle: Estimated share of the population living in cities with 1 million or more people. City boundaries are defined using a consistent global approach based on satellite imagery and population data.

title: Urban area over the long-term
subtitle: Estimated urban area by region or country, measured in square kilometers (km²) is calculated by dividing the total urban population of a country in a given year by the average urban densities in that country during the same year.

title: Urban policies that respond to population dynamics
subtitle: Countries that have national urban policies or regional development plans that respond to population dynamics, ensure balanced territorial development, and increase local fiscal space.

title: Number of people living in urban slum households
subtitle: A slum household is defined as a group of individuals living under the same roof lacking one or more of the following conditions: access to improved water and sanitation, sufficient living area, housing durability, and security of tenure.

title: Share of population living in urban areas projected to 2050
subtitle: Share of the population living in urban and rural areas, combining UN estimates and projections with modelled historical data.

title: Share of population living in urban areas
subtitle: Estimated share of the population living in urban areas (the sum of cities and towns and suburbs).

title: Do more people live in urban or rural areas?
subtitle: A country is classified as "majority urban" when over half its population lives in urban areas, and "majority rural" when over half lives in rural areas. This indicator combines UN estimates with modelled historical data.

title: Value of exported goods and services
subtitle: Value of exported goods and market services provided to the rest of the world. This data is expressed in US dollars, adjusted for inflation.

title: Value of imported goods and services
subtitle: Value of imported goods and market services received from the rest of the world. This data is expressed in US dollars, adjusted for inflation.

title: Vegetable consumption per capita
subtitle: Average per capita vegetable consumption, measured in kilograms per person per year.

title: Transit stations: How did the number of visitors change relative to before the pandemic?
subtitle: Transit stations include public transport hubs such as subway, bus, and train stations.

title: Share of children receiving vitamin A supplementation
subtitle: The share of children aged between 6 months and 5 years who received at least two high-dose vitamin A capsules in the previous year.

title: Voter turnout of registered voters
subtitle: Percentage of all registered voters who cast a vote in the national election, according to official results.

title: Voter turnout of voting-age population
subtitle: Percentage of voting-age population who cast a vote in the national election, according to official results.

title: Share of domestic wastewater that is safely treated
subtitle: The proportion of wastewater from households and the service industry that is safely treated at the source or through centralized wastewater treatment plants before being discharged into the environment.

title: Percentage of shared water basins managed by international cooperation
subtitle: Share of transboundary basins area with an operational arrangement for water cooperation. This shows how much of the total internationally shared water resources are managed through active cooperation between countries, which helps prevent conflict and support sustainable use.

title: Water productivity, GDP per cubic meter of freshwater withdrawal
subtitle: Water productivity is calculated as total gross domestic product (GDP), measured in constant 2015 US$ divided by annual total water withdrawal.

title: Water withdrawals per capita
subtitle: Total water withdrawals from agricultural, industrial and municipal purposes per capita, measured in cubic meters (m³) per year.

title: Weekly area burnt by wildfires
subtitle: Area burnt by wildfires in hectares.

title: Weekly confirmed COVID-19 cases
subtitle: Weekly confirmed cases refer to the cumulative number of cases over the previous week.

title: Weekly confirmed COVID-19 deaths
subtitle: Weekly confirmed deaths refer to the cumulative number of confirmed deaths over the previous week. Due to varying protocols and challenges in the attribution of the cause of death, the number of confirmed deaths may not accurately represent the true number of deaths caused by COVID-19.

title: Weekly confirmed COVID-19 deaths per million people
subtitle: Weekly confirmed deaths refer to the cumulative number of confirmed deaths over the previous week. Due to varying protocols and challenges in the attribution of the cause of death, the number of confirmed deaths may not accurately represent the true number of deaths caused by COVID-19.

title: Week by week change in confirmed COVID-19 cases
subtitle: The weekly change on any given date measures the percentage change in the number of new confirmed cases over the last seven days relative to the number in the previous seven days. Due to limited testing, the number of confirmed cases is lower than the true number of infections.

title: Week by week change of confirmed COVID-19 deaths
subtitle: The weekly change on any given date measures the percentage change in number of confirmed deaths over the last seven days relative to the number in the previous seven days. Due to varying protocols and challenges in the attribution of the cause of death, the number of confirmed deaths may not accurately represent the true number of deaths caused by COVID-19.

title: Weekly new hospital admissions for COVID-19
Weekly new hospital admissions for COVID-19 per million
Weekly new ICU admissions for COVID-19
Weekly new ICU admissions for COVID-19 per million
Weekly share of the total land area burnt by wildfires
subtitle: The total area consumed by wildfires is recorded for each fire event, even if fires occur in the same location multiple times.

title: Emissions-weighted carbon price in emissions trading systems
subtitle: The emissions-weighted carbon price in emissions trading systems (ETS) is calculated for the whole economy by multiplying each sector's (e.g. electricity, or road transport) carbon price by its contribution to a country's carbon dioxide emissions.

title: Availability of flu vaccines
subtitle: This shows whether influenza vaccines were available to each country's public or private sector during the year or flu season.

title: Wheat production
subtitle: Wheat production is measured in tonnes.

title: Wheat yields
subtitle: Yields are measured in tonnes per hectare.

title: Wine as a share of total alcohol consumption
subtitle: Wine as a share of total alcohol consumption, as measured by intake in litres of pure alcohol.

title: Wine consumption per person
subtitle: Average per capita consumption of wine, as measured in liters of pure alcohol per year. 1 liter of wine contains around 0.12 liters of pure alcohol.

title: Women and men have the same rights to own property
Women can take the same jobs as men
