Women's Civil Liberties Index
subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which women are free from forced labor, have property rights and access to the justice system, and enjoy freedom of movement. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most rights).

title: Women's Civil Society Participation Index
subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which women can discuss political issues, participate in civil society organizations, and are represented among journalists. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most participatory).

title: Women who make informed decisions regarding their sexual relations, contraceptive use and reproductive health care
subtitle: Women aged 15-49 (married or in union) who can say no to sexual intercourse with their husband or partner if they do not want, decide on use of contraception, and decide on their own health care.

title: Share of women who were married by age 15
subtitle: Women aged 20-24, who were married or in a union before they reached the age of 15.

title: Share of women who were married by age 18
subtitle: Women aged 20-24, who were married or in a union before they reached the age of 18.

title: Women's Political Empowerment Index
subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which women enjoy civil liberties, can participate in civil society, and are represented in politics. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most empowered).

title: Women's Political Participation Index
subtitle: Data by V-Dem. Expert estimates of the extent to which women are represented in the legislature and have an equal share of political power. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most equal).

title: Married women are required by law to obey their husbands
subtitle: Any provision stating that married women must obey their husband or if disobeying their husband has legal ramifications for them, such as loss of their right to maintenance.

title: Share of young women who experienced sexual violence as children
subtitle: Women aged 18-29 years old who experienced any form of sexual violence before reaching the age of 18. Data is from 2005-2024.

title: Workplaces: How did the number of visitors change relative to before the pandemic?
World Bank income groups
subtitle: The World Bank's income classification divides countries into four categories based on their gross national income (GNI) per capita. Thresholds between income groups have changed over time.

title: When were countries certified free of guinea worm disease?
subtitle: To be certified as free of guinea worm disease, a country must have reported zero indigenous cases through active surveillance for at least three consecutive years.

title: Elimination status of maternal and neonatal tetanus
subtitle: Maternal and neonatal tetanus is a life-threatening disease that occurs when newborns are infected with tetanus. It can be prevented through maternal vaccination and hygienic childbirth practices.

title: Year of the last reported rinderpest case
subtitle: Rinderpest, also known as cattle plague, was a disease that infected ruminant animals, primarily cattle and buffalo. The last outbreak was recorded in Kenya in 2001 and the disease was officially declared eradicated in 2011.

title: Annual number of objects launched into space
subtitle: This includes satellites, probes, landers, crewed spacecrafts, and space station flight elements launched into Earth orbit or beyond.

title: Average years of schooling
subtitle: Average number of years adults over 25 years participated in formal education.

title: Which countries overapplied nitrogen without gains in crop yields?
subtitle: Shown is how much nitrogen pollution countries caused compared with how much they reduced their yield gaps relative to directly neighboring countries. Positive values (yellow to red) indicate a country overapplied nitrogen without gains in yield. This is based on yield gap and nitrogen data published between 2012 and 2015.

title: Share of young people with knowledge on HIV prevention
subtitle: Share of young people of both sexes, aged 15-24 years old, who could answer a full set of questions on HIV prevention correctly.

title: Youth mortality rate
subtitle: Estimated share of children who die before age 15. A rate of 1% means one death for every 100 live births.

title: Share of young people not in education, employment or training
